MUFG Bank has not purchased or accumulated XRP on its balance sheet. The confusion stems from online rumors that mix up MUFG's past testing of Ripple's settlement software (RippleNet) with buying the native XRP cryptocurrency token. Furthermore, MUFG's primary digital asset focus involves developing bank-backed yen stablecoins and tokenized assets rather than holding public cryptocurrencies.

Most stories regarding Japanese banking group involvement with XRP actually refer to SBI Holdings (and its subsidiary SBI Shinsei Bank). SBI maintains a close partnership with Ripple to facilitate remittance products and has periodically offered small XRP bonus rewards or interest deposit options to retail customers. However, neither MUFG nor any other major Japanese bank purchases XRP as an institutional balance sheet reserve asset.
